howto.name: Upload the Word document
howto.text: Select a .doc or .docx file up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Conversion runs automatically
howto.text: LibreOffice converts the document server-side, preserving formatting, images, headers, footers, and table-of-contents links.

howto.name: Download the PDF
howto.text: Click Convert and save the result. Hyperlinks and bookmarks from the original document are preserved.

faq.a: Yes. LibreOffice preserves fonts, styles, tables, images, headers, footers, and table-of-contents links. Minor differences may occur with uncommon fonts.
Yes. Both the older .doc format and the modern .docx format are supported.

faq.q: What about tracked changes and comments?
faq.a: Tracked changes and comments visible in the document will appear in the PDF. Accept or reject changes in Word first if you want a clean output.
